mods.name: FreeCam
mods.description: Explore scenes with a free camera, teleport the player, and save camera positions per map.
mods.controls: F5: camera on/off; F6: mode; W/A/S/D: move; mouse: look; E/Space: up; Q/Ctrl: down; Shift: boost. Page Up/Down: speed; Home: reset speed; T: teleport player. Ctrl+1-5: save positions; 1-5: recall. The keys above can be changed.

settings.label: Camera mode
settings.description: Choose how FreeCam takes control of the camera. Switch modes while FreeCam is off.

option_descriptions.possess: Spawn and possess a collision-free spectator pawn using engine movement. This is the default mode.
option_descriptions.viewtarget: Keep the player pawn and move a separate camera. Try this fallback if possess interferes with a scene.

settings.label: Movement speed (cm/s)
settings.description: Base camera movement speed in Unreal centimetres per second. Larger values move farther each second.

settings.label: Speed boost multiplier
settings.description: Multiplies movement speed while Shift is held. A value of 4 makes boosted movement four times faster.

settings.label: Viewtarget mouse sensitivity
settings.description: Mouse-look sensitivity in viewtarget mode. This preference does not change possess mode mouse input.

settings.label: Camera interval (ms)
settings.description: Delay between camera updates in milliseconds. Smaller values update more frequently and can use more CPU.

settings.label: Toggle camera
settings.description: Turn the free camera on or off. Turn it off before changing scenes.

settings.label: Switch mode
settings.description: Switch between possess and viewtarget while the free camera is off. The shortcut changes the mode for this game session.

settings.label: Increase speed
settings.description: Increase the current camera movement speed during this game session.

settings.label: Decrease speed
settings.description: Decrease the current camera movement speed during this game session.

settings.label: Reset speed
settings.description: Restore the current movement speed to the configured base speed.

settings.label: Teleport player
settings.description: Move the player to the free camera position in search mode. Use care near geometry and scene boundaries.

mods.name: LightTools
mods.description: Adjust scene lighting, camera light, fog, post-processing, shadows, and exposure.
mods.controls: F1: floodlight; F2: camera light; F3: fog; F4: post-processing; F7: shadows. +/-: exposure; Ctrl +/-: light intensity; Num0/End: reset. The keys above can be changed.

settings.label: Floodlight intensity (lux)
settings.description: Brightness of the additional scene floodlight in lux. Existing scene lighting can make the result vary.

settings.label: Camera light intensity (cd)
settings.description: Brightness of the light attached to the camera, in candela.

settings.label: Camera light radius (cm)
settings.description: Maximum reach of the camera light in Unreal centimetres.

settings.label: Exposure step
settings.description: Amount added or removed by each brightness shortcut. The mod uses colour grading for this adjustment.

settings.label: Light update interval (ms)
settings.description: Delay between lighting updates in milliseconds. Smaller values update more frequently and can use more CPU.

settings.label: Toggle floodlight
settings.description: Toggle the additional floodlight.

settings.label: Toggle camera light
settings.description: Toggle the light that follows the camera.

settings.label: Toggle fog
settings.description: Toggle the mod fog override.

settings.label: Toggle post-processing
settings.description: Toggle the post-processing override. Exposure and colour effects depend on the scene.

settings.label: Toggle shadows
settings.description: Toggle the mod shadow override.

mods.name: FamSwap
mods.description: Replace Fam behind the bar and at the table with your own images. Missing images keep the original.
mods.controls: F8: replacement on/off; F9: reload images. Table mode always replaces videos; idle only replaces Fam while no Fam video is playing. The keys above can be changed.

settings.label: Table image mode
settings.description: Choose when the table replacement image is shown. Bar image replacement is separate.

option_descriptions.idle: Show the table replacement while idle so game video scenes can remain visible.

settings.label: Hide Fam animation layers while active
settings.description: Hide the related flipbook elements while applying the image replacement.

settings.label: Image update interval (ms)
settings.description: Delay between replacement checks in milliseconds. Smaller values react sooner and can use more CPU.

settings.label: Toggle replacement
settings.description: Toggle FamSwap replacements for this game session.

settings.label: Reload images
settings.description: Rescan replacement image files after changing them.

mods.name: MovieSwap
mods.description: Replace known game videos with your own MP4 files while keeping the original when a replacement is missing.
mods.controls: F11: rescan replacement videos. Video imports copy the selected file into the matching game-relative path. Fam videos need a pure green background; preserve the original dimensions, codec, frame rate, and duration when possible. The keys above can be changed.

settings.label: Video scan interval (ms)
settings.description: Delay between scans for replacement video files in milliseconds.

settings.label: Rescan videos
settings.description: Rescan replacement video files immediately. Restart the game after removing replacements.
